chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Shammun, from Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Mismāʿ ibn Abd al-Malik, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Indeed, ʿAlī عليه السلام ruled concerning the tooth of a child, before he loses it and it is replaced, that for each tooth there is one camel.

key_terms.بَعِيراً: one camel, the specified compensation amount
key_terms.سِنِّ: tooth, the injured body part under discussion
key_terms.قَضَى: gave a legal ruling or judgment
key_terms.يَثَّغِرَ: to lose the milk tooth and have another tooth come in its place

ai.seo_question: What is the compensation for knocking out a child’s tooth before it is replaced?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling from Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام regarding compensation for a child’s tooth before the stage at which it falls out and is replaced. It establishes a fixed diyah amount of one camel for each such tooth.
